The moderate ranking stability (ranking_tau) and high error spread suggest that a non-linear weighting like softmax might better isolate the top performers compared to the inverse error weighting used in the leader.
Given the moderate ranking stability (ranking_tau: 0.361), I want to test if focusing the combination on the top-performing models reduces error by excluding the long tail of the model pool.
Testing if softmax weighting on the top-k pool is more effective than inverse error weighting.

Given the moderate ranking stability (Kendall tau 0.361), I want to test if the Caruana-selected subset in pool5, which focuses on model complementarity, performs better when weighted by inverse error.

The moderate ranking stability (ranking tau) suggests that the best models may vary across the forecast horizon, so I will test a per-horizon top-k weighting strategy using the recently prepared handle w7.
Testing DBA on the full pool to see if it handles the moderate ranking stability better than weighted or trimmed mean strategies.
The moderate ranking stability (ranking_tau) suggests that while weighting is helpful, the top models in the pool might be consistent enough that a simple mean could provide a robust baseline.
The moderate ranking stability (ranking_tau) and noisy regime suggest that a robust estimator like the median might perform well across the full pool.
Testing if a per-series meta-model can better capture the combination of models given the moderate ranking stability.

The moderate ranking stability (ranking_tau 0.361) and the presence of a trend (trend_strength 0.484) suggest that a shape-based combination like DBA might better capture the series trajectory than simple weighting, particularly when restricted to the high-performing pool4.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool5 weighted by w6' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.757. Series context: trend strength 0.484 and seasonal strength 0.0; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.361); 9 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 5.842.
